parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_projects, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_projects, AVG(budget) as avg_budget, SUM(spent) as total_spent FROM projects

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_tasks, AVG(CASE WHEN completedAt IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completedAt - createdAt))/3600 END) as avg_completion_hours FROM tasks WHERE createdAt >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
